audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-14 CLOSURE ROUND - the pure flip, no new ink. BOTH report-014 boxes close at this single flip - the Name That Monster Contest #1 winners (folio 3) and the Gregory Rihn lycanthropy variant (folios 29-32) - 2 closed / 0 open in tools/dragon_gap_report_014.md; the two-chain walk completes in two rounds (R925 opener carrying both chains, this flip), the issue-11 two-round pattern. The bookkeeping pins: the two boxes and their two chains, the issue-13 report complete at 2 / 0 since R924, the issue-12 report at 2 / 0 since R921, the issue-11 report at 1 / 0 since R918, the issue-10 report at 2 / 0 since R916, the issue-9 report at 1 / 0 since R913, the issue-8 report at 1 / 0 since R911, the issue-7 report at 1 / 0 since R909, the issue-6 report at 1 / 0 since R907, and the registry ground truth carried forward unchanged from the R924 re-measure - 1313 defs loaded, 1338 base lua files, 25 never-load errors, the battery line the only ground truth. Per the go-ahead adjudication the scoped-out ink stays scoped - the SPACE MARINES article, the M-A Variant and the Total Person charts (other systems), the reviews, the Rust Monster interview (humor, the polymorphed-NPC rule IDEAS USABLE), the Monty Haul satire, the editorial, the comics and the ads. The slipped brawling sequel still has not printed - the watch continues at TD 15, which teases the Green Magician and Dragon Magic.

banner.provenance: Bookkeeping only, no new ink pinned. The issue-14 walk (the R925 opener carrying both chains, this flip) covered The Dragon Vol. II No. 8 (May 1978), the archive.org scan voice, single-voice - no chat-side upload cross-check exists for issue 14; the source lives in the archive.org item accessory-dragon-magazine-012, which holds issues 7-14. The transcripts ride extract/dragon/014/p001 through p036, landed at R925; print folio = PDF page minus two in this issue.
banner.sentinel: The R925 sentinel pins ride unchanged - the Jarnkung hit-dice bar garble resolved at the full-res scan to 5, the Crawler 3 1/2 prose pinned as the dice and the 7-halves total, the experience-grid row-4 cell pinned as-scanned at 1000 with the dropped zero noted, the change-time in halves and the predominance ladder with its printed leading zeros all ride as pinned, noted never silent. The registry ground truth carried forward unchanged from the R924 re-measure: 1313 loaded / 1338 base / 25 never-load.
